⚠️ TRAFFIC ADVISORY

KAPCHORWA – SUAM ROAD EXPERIENCING LANDSLIDES

The Ministry of Works and Transport wishes to inform the general public that the Kapchorwa – Suam Road [Eastern Uganda] continues to experience landslides following the ongoing heavy rains in the area.

Additional slides have been reported this morning along Km 43 [Kowobelyo village, Bukwo District] from Kapchorwa, making travel along this section unsafe at the moment. 

Our technical teams are on ground assessing the extent of the damage and coordinating efforts to undertake emergency clearance and the needed stabilization works.

🛑Motorists and the general public are strongly advised to; 
•Avoid crossing the affected sections
•Exercise maximum caution and follow safety measures on site.
•Consider alternative routes where possible until the situation normalizes.

The Ministry appreciates the cooperation of the public as efforts continue to restore safe passage. 

Further updates will be shared as the situation evolves.

31st October 2025
